newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bonds end flat, tobacco bonds fall.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bonds end flat, tobacco bonds fall.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond prices ended unchanged to slightly firmer but spreads on tobacco bonds continued to widen following Thursday's news of a potential downgrade to companies exposed to U.S. litigation.
"Spreads on tobacco bonds widened again," said one corporate bond trader who trades industrials at a U.S. investment bank in New York.
On Thursday, Standard & Poor's said it may cut the ratings of tobacco companies with U.S. litigation exposure.
RJR's 8-3/4 percent bonds due 2005 were quoted about five basis points wider at 230 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
